name: Tennessee State University
academic_ranking: Tennessee State University is a public, historically Black land-grant university (HBCU) in Nashville, TN. It offers a broad range of undergraduate and graduate programs across colleges including Business, Engineering, Education, Health Sciences, and Agriculture. Regionally accredited (SACSCOC).
financial_aid: As a public land-grant HBCU, TSU offers in-state and out-of-state tuition rates plus need- and merit-based aid, federal aid (Pell/loans), and athletic scholarships administered through the athletics department. Specific published tuition figures were not confirmable from a primary source during research (2026-07); left null rather than estimated.
facilities_notes: TSU softball competes as an NCAA Division I program within the Ohio Valley Conference. Specific softball facility details (home field/stadium) were not available on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program at an HBCU competing in the Ohio Valley Conference. Team social handle is @TNStateSoftball. No detailed recent-performance narrative was populated on the program pages checked 2026-07.
